'''RC-P9''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that was stationed near the farms of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the [[Invasion of Ossus]]. Having intercepted the Imperial communications, the battle droid's primary programming was to stop the incoming hostile Imperial forces, likely heading for the farmsteads close-by. RC-P9 was however too slow to intervene and therefore had to brief other Republic forces about the planned attack as well as activity of mutated [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] threatening the lives of defenseless civilians.<ref name="Hold the Line" />
